text:
```yaml
name: Claude Code Review
on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  pull_request_review_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  claude-code-review:
    if: github.event.issue.pull_request || github.event.comment.in_reply_to_id
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - name: Get changed files
        id: changed-files
        uses: Ana06/get-changed-files@v2.3.0
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Run Claude Code
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          trigger_phrase: "@claude"
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          allowed_bots: false
          allowed_non_write_users: false
          include_comments_by_actor: true
          exclude_comments_by_actor: false
          settings: |
            {
              "tools": [
                "read_file",
                "write_file",
                "create_branch",
                "commit_changes",
                "create_pull_request",
                "comment_on_issue"
              ]
            }
```
